title: Document/confirm debt-weighted STAR happiness formula
reason: Already implemented exactly as described in src/tally.js's happiness()/applyRound() (stake = (hi-lo)/5, happiness measured from lo) — this reads as explaining the existing design rather than requesting a change.

title: Remove login gate from the almanac page
reason: The almanac's tag feature shows which member tagged each book and calls the members-only /api/tags endpoint, so ungating it as-is would leak member names and break for unauthenticated visitors — not a small safe change without reworking the tags section.

title: Add short, spoiler-free one-to-three-sentence book descriptions
reason: The scope question went unanswered, and producing accurate neutral descriptions at this quality bar is an editorial/content task (or would need a paid LLM service) rather than a small code change the site can build on its own.

title: Line graph of nominated/picked authors' sex over time
reason: No code changes. I did not build "a line graph showing picked authors' sex over time."

title: Rewrite the site in enterprise Java
reason: Plainly a joke, and a rewrite into Java isn't a change this Cloudflare Pages site could use.

title: Track AI usage and show a tree-planting offset counter
reason: The site has no access to the subscription's usage data, and the maintainer confirmed it can't really be tracked, so any number would be made up.
